summaries.title: Condition-Aware Neural Network for Controlled Image Generation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Condition-Aware Neural Network for Controlled** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉生成与世界模型（Vision & World），并引入 Condition-Aware Neural Network (CAN) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We present Condition-Aware Neural Network (CAN), a new method for adding control to image generative models。
